analysis.headline: Multi-Horizon Rotation Analysis: Defensive and Regional Leadership Persists Amid Growth and Energy Score Compression
analysis.market_regime: Defensive Sector Leadership and Regional Divergence
analysis.executive_summary: Deterministic rotation monitoring confirms sustained relative leadership in defensive sectors such as Medical Devices (IHI, confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 87.8) and Consumer Staples (XLP, confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 81.11), alongside broad international developed markets like EAFE (EFA, score 85.0). Conversely, growth and cyclical themes face rotation out, exemplified by Semiconductors (SMH, confirmed ROTATION_OUT, score 16.6) and Large-Cap Growth (IWF, confirmed ROTATION_OUT, score 22.13). Real Estate (XLRE, score 72.5) and Global Utilities (JXI, score 74.5) show emerging relative momentum, while Energy E&P (XOP, confirmed WEAKENING, score 19.4) experiences a 63-bar score low. Highlighting key style dynamics, Value (IWD) continues leading Growth (IWF), and Equal-Weight S&P 500 (RSP) leads Cap-Weight S&P 500 (SPY).

risks_or_conflicts: A significant Health Care sector divergence exists: Pharmaceuticals (XPH, 20-bar score change of 26.72) is improving, whereas Health Care Providers (IHF, 20-bar score change of -37.39) is deteriorating, creating a divergence spread of 64.1 points.
No pair-state tensions are currently flagged by Python.

Divergent relative strength signals exist across short and long horizons for several ETFs: Health Care Providers (IHF) shows 20-bar relative strength of -4.9 percentage points versus 63-bar relative strength of 1.44 percentage points; Pharmaceuticals (XPH) exhibits 4.96 percentage points over 20 bars versus -6.55 percentage points over 63 bars; Energy (XLE) shows -3.59 percentage points over 20 bars versus 2.53 percentage points over 63 bars; Canada (EWC) shows -1.84 percentage points over 20 bars versus 1.24 percentage points over 63 bars; and Cyber Security (CIBR) shows -1.31 percentage points over 20 bars versus 6.81 percentage points over 63 bars.

Pending trend changes introduce early warnings for confirmed leaders and emerging funds: Switzerland (EWL, confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER) and Mexico (EWW, confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER) carry pending WEAKENING raw states at 2/3 observations; Oil & Gas E&P (XOP, confirmed WEAKENING) carries a pending ROTATION_OUT raw state at 2/3 observations; while Small Caps (IWM, confirmed EMERGING) and MidCap 400 (MDY, confirmed EMERGING) carry pending NEUTRAL raw states at 2/3 observations.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
